name: android-devkit
description: Android development environment for Claude Code: Play Store shipping discipline, accessibility review, and event-driven GitHub CI/CD.

plugins.name: android-devkit
plugins.description: Opinionated Android + GitHub + software-engineering environment: subagents for accessibility review, codebase-rot auditing and documentation health; skills for running on-device, Play Store release compliance, prototype-to-production refactoring, i18n and Compose UI; hooks that format Kotlin and enforce issue-to-PR traceability; and a one-shot project initializer that provisions the whole GitHub CI/CD setup.
